text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging alex (oncall) — p99 latency spike detected for /v1/chat/completions across us-west-2 cluster. alert: route.chat.completions.p99 > 1200ms (sustained 6m).

alex: I’m up. Looking at graphs now — seeing a correlated bump on model:mistral-1 and model:guanaco-7b-quant. CPU on inference nodes is fine, but queue length doubled.

maria: tagging @alex — customer reports of slow responses started ~08:12 UTC. Any 5xxs?

alex: no 5xxs in logs, just increased tail latency. Traces show requests waiting in per-tenant queue ~400ms before starting inference.

sam: is this a routing/regional hot-spot? any recent deploys?

alex: no deploys in last hour. Autoscaler did a couple of scale-outs but they lagged. Looks like batching thresholds weren’t firing due to shorter sequences — reduced effective throughput.

jin: I can flip a temporary mitigation: lower min-batch-delay to force wider batching for the affected routes. Will that be safe?

alex: can try on a single node group (canary) first. If it helps, we can roll.

ops-bot: runbook excerpt — When p99 chat latency > 1.2s for >5m: 1) identify hot routes/models, 2) try batching tweak or fallback to lighter quantized model, 3) consider emergency threshold ratchet.

alex: doing canary change on us-west-2 pool-3: set min_batch_delay_ms=8 -> 12, and max_batch_size=64 -> 96. Will watch for 2 mins.

maria: FYI @product: we briefly saw user-facing slowness for a single enterprise customer. I sent a proactive note to AE.

claira: note — telemetry shows chat routing to guanaco-7b-quant spikes 3x for long prompts; might be due to a new prompt template hitting our fallback path. Raising for later triage.

alex: canary applied. Initial p95/p99 show small improvement for guanaco-7b-quant. p99 dropped from ~1450ms -> ~980ms on that canary host.

sam: nice. If canary is good at 2m, roll to remaining us-west-2 pools?

alex: will do a controlled roll. rolling patch to pool-1/2/4 with 30s between hosts.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: rolling change started by alex. 6 hosts to update.

maria: question: should we also adjust alert thresholds temporarily to reduce noise until roll stabilizes? Current squelch rules are noisy for multi-tenant spikes.

jin: yes — propose we ratchet p99 alert for chat.completions in us-west-2 from 1200ms -> 1600ms for 2 hours, and p95 from 400ms -> 600ms. Keep per-model overrides for mission-critical models at original thresholds.

sam: I prefer targetting by route+model instead of region-wide. We saw only guanaco-7b-quant and mistral-1. Could we set p99 for route:chat.completions+model:guanaco-7b-quant to 1600ms, and leave others?

alex: that works. Need a quick dashboard panel so oncall can see which models still breach. I’ll add a temporary dashboard and share link.

alex: dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abc123/latency-playback?from=now-30m&to=now — added model split row and per-route heatmap.

claira: can we also create an alert that triggers when queue length > 8 for >2m? That would allow earlier mitigation without waiting for p99 spike.

jin: yes. I’ll open a quick PR for queue-length alert with runbook.

ops-bot: incident severity note — customer impact: intermittent slowness, degraded UX but no errors. Impact scope: single large customer + a small percentage of general traffic.

maria: ok moving to handoff — alex can continue rollback/rollout for 15 more mins then handoff to jin for follow-up tuning and alerts.

alex: acknowledged. Handoff to jin at 08:45 UTC. Final state before handoff: batching changes rolled to all us-west-2 pools, p99 reduced to ~900-1100ms cluster-wide. Rolling average still high for mistral-1 in route A.

jin: on it. I’ll keep the temporary per-model threshold in place and push queue-length alert. Also will add a permanent dashboard tile to product alerts.

sam: please file a postmortem ticket with actions: 1) evaluate batching autodetection heuristics for short sequences, 2) add model-aware alerting (per-route+per-model), 3) implement queue-length early-warning, 4) review autoscaler responsiveness.

maria: creating PM ticket now: PM-4729. Linking to dashboard and actions.

alex: post-incident follow-ups assigned: alex (batch heuristics), jin (alerts + dashboard), sam (autoscale investigation), claira (prompt-template triage).

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: 2d follow-up sync on actions.

maria: thumbs up to everyone — great coordination. :thumbsup: Closing the incident channel once jin confirms stable for 1h.

jin: will report back in 45m with final state.

alex: leaving a quick log snippet for the change in case we need rollback:

```
# canary patch
min_batch_delay_ms: 8 -> 12
max_batch_size: 64 -> 96
applied_to: pool-3 canary host
```

jin: copying runbook additions to infra-alerts repo. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-alerts/pulls/812

incident-bot: incident resolved (mitigation applied). Monitor window started at 08:24 UTC.

jin: update — 45m after roll, p99 steady ~950-1100ms, queue-length alerts firing briefly once then cleared. I’m going to keep the temporary p99 ratchet on guanaco-7b-quant for 2 hours, then revert if stable.

maria: thanks — closing this thread in 1h if no regressions.
